milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the coal block at spawn-relative (3, 1, 7) and face toward it, modeling that the player can visually observe the target. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range on the flat 21x21 platform (coal block is ~7.68 blocks from spawn), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the coal block rather than facing away.
